featured_reviews.review_text:
Quick and prompt response. Reached out to a Pawan and he redirected me to another team member who reached out to me for my address. He was at my place in 15 minutes. Gracefully and carefully rescued the snake from my house. Thank you for saving the day!

featured_reviews.name: vijay kini
featured_reviews.review_text: Selfless service by the RAWW team headed by Pawan Sir and ably supported by Kunal, Ritwik, Bharat bhai to safely rescue a baby langur stuck inside a balcony grill and reunite it with it's mother. Required lot of patience. Hats off to you guys, keep up the good work and God bless.

featured_reviews.name: RAJ SHAH
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had resqued a Owl entangled in Manja at a height of 30 feet with the help of Fire Brigade. It was injured in wings and totally exhausted and just could not move. Mr Aman Shaj reached us in 10 mins after the call. He was very compassionate towards and checked every details about it.. Handled it very concern.. He than took it with him to be released in wild life..
Thanks Mr Aman for helping and also informing about RAWW and the services provided.. Raj Shaj

featured_reviews.name: Kimberley Parker
featured_reviews.review_text: Guys Im not sure what is going on here but one of your volunteers have just led me on a wild goose chase needlessly.  Alot of injured birds tend to land at my door for healing, and I always do my best to have them sent to the Bandra Hill road Animal hospital for healing, unfortunately today the person who takes them for me is on vacation so I had to reach out to various ngos etc asking whether anyone is available to help with this.Your volunteer gave me a contact and asked me to get in touch directly which I did, to my surpise the person said they only work in the Andheri Area. When I told your conact person this , they said "Madam we tried to help you." So I want to make this simple point. How do you think you are helping by giving me irrelevant details? If you dont have volunteers or a means to help in my area thats fine, but why not just say that ? This is a service ALL of us are committed to, it can only sustain if we are considerate surely?

featured_reviews.name: Dinisha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m honestly really thankful to Ritik sir for helping me out so quickly. Everything happened so fast and smoothly, and it made a very stressful situation much easier to handle. The way he handled everything was calm and straightforward, and he didn’t waste any time.
You can genuinely tell that he and the team truly care about what they’re doing and about the animals they help. That really stood out to us.
Really appreciate the quick response and the support throughout. Thank you again for stepping in and helping when it was needed. You guys are god sent angels 🫶🏻

featured_reviews.name: Jayashree Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I informed RAWW about a bird laying helpless in our Harmony Society ground and within 10 mins Aman S came for the rescue. This was really fast and the bird was rescued on time. I appreciate and thank Aman and his team for the great work they are doing. God bless 🙌🏻
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your efforts in initiating the rescue ma'am and also for the kind words for our team.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: I saw a pigeon which was injured and was unable to fly, we took with us and called Raw, There volunteer turned up within 25 minutes and took the soul to treat. Grateful to RAWW, much needed organisation like RAWW. Thank you Pawan bhai for super response
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for initiating the rescue and kind words for our team.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Borade
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently had a snake spotted in our society late at night, and the Hope Foundation team responded immediately when we contacted them at midnight. They arrived quickly, handled the situation very professionally, and safely rescued the snake with proper care and expertise. Truly grateful for their fast response and dedication to both people and wildlife. Thank you, Hope Foundation, for your amazing work!

featured_reviews.name: Yash Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was trying to get a street dog admited. He has bot flies all over, he was walking in circles and almost a skeleton. He was not eating anything.

They told me they don't take animals with ticks, fleas, or botflies. As it would "spread to other animals".... You are literally an animal clinic and rescue organisation. It's your job to look after the sick and isolate to animal with contagious condition. They are actively declining animals with most common aliment.

So what, you only take animals with lavish background? All streets animals have some sort of fleas and ticks. It's like human hospital not talking anyone with common cold as it would spread to others.

As I was trying to point out the absurdity of the whole thing. She got mad.

featured_reviews.name: Sanya Bahadur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last year I had rescued an indie cat named Cheese from the streets and due to family issues, could'nt adopt him. We immediately called Hope Foundation for foster care services and since then, Rohitji & his wife have been taking very good care of Cheese👍

They have informed me from time to time about his medical issues, shared his updates and taken care of him when he fell sick. Cheese too is very happy with them.

Hope Foundation was my last hope to ensure that Cheese gets to live a sheltered life, safely and away from the streets. And I will always remain grateful to them for helping both me & Cheese at our time of need🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: Chaitali Salvi
featured_reviews.review_text: Our society cat Boku was badly injured. Even the animal hospital and ambulance refused help over the long weekend, saying no doctors were available, but Hope Foundation stepped in immediately. They not only responded quickly, but also took such good care of him, and ensured us he was looked after with love. The team was extremely cooperative, gave us regular updates, and their compassion truly made a difference. We are deeply grateful for your support.

featured_reviews.name: Sumeet Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Came across a dehydrated Black Kite one evening in my society and called them for rescue.
Rohit Khuranna and his team handled it in professional manner and you could see the love and dedication that they put forth.
So grateful this foundation exists - definitely worth supporting them 💯💯.

featured_reviews.name: Ashween Menda
featured_reviews.review_text:
We called for snake at home at Mamta, opp Santosh mata mandir.

call reply and instant help in minites.
They took the snake safely.
Truly thankful.

featured_reviews.name: Saumya Chaudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
I called them for urgent help for a dog in my neighbourhood, and all they cared about was money. The entire conversation revolved around payment, not the suffering animal. Eventually, help was flat out denied. One woman I spoke to was outright dismissive and refused to do anything.
If your only motive is to make money, don’t hide behind the label of an NGO. Turning away helpless animals while preaching “welfare” is shameful. This organisation should seriously question its ethics. Absolutely disgraceful.

इस पावन अवसर पर महाशिवरात्रि के दिन आइए याद रखें —
“हर जीव में शिव बसते हैं।”

भगवान शिव हमें करुणा, दया और हर प्राणी के प्रति सम्मान का संदेश देते हैं।
इस दिन को केवल पूजा तक सीमित न रखें, बल्कि पशुओं और प्रकृति के प्रति प्रेम और सेवा के कार्यों से भी मनाएँ।

आइए संरक्षण करें, सेवा करें और स्नेह दें — क्योंकि हर जीवन में ईश्वर का वास है। 🐾

आप सभी को महाशिवरात्रि की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ।

या पवित्र महाशिवरात्रीच्या दिवशी आपण लक्षात ठेवूया —
“प्रत्येक जीवामध्ये शिव वास करतात.”

भगवान शिव आपल्याला करुणा, दया आणि प्रत्येक सजीवाप्रती आदर ठेवण्याचा संदेश देतात.
ही शिवरात्र फक्त पूजा करूनच नाही, तर प्राणी आणि निसर्गाविषयी प्रेम व सेवाभावाने साजरी करूया.

चला संरक्षण करूया, सेवा करूया आणि माया देऊया — कारण प्रत्येक जीवामध्ये ईश्वर आहे. 🐾

Animals have rights too—and it is our responsibility to know and uphold them.
Animal welfare laws are designed to protect animals from cruelty, neglect, and abuse, ensuring they live with dignity and care. When we are informed about these laws, we become stronger voices for those who cannot speak for themselves.

Know a few important animal welfare rules in India:
• Causing cruelty, injury, or abandonment of animals is a punishable offence under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960.
• Feeding or caring for community animals is legal and protected.
• Injured or sick animals must be given timely medical care.
• Animals have the right to food, water, shelter, and freedom from pain and fear.

Being aware is the first step towards action. Let’s stand together as responsible citizens and create a safer, more compassionate society for all living beings.

प्राण्यांनाही हक्क आहेत—आणि ते जाणून घेणे व त्यांचे संरक्षण करणे ही आपली जबाबदारी आहे.
प्राणी कल्याण कायदे प्राण्यांना क्रूरता, दुर्लक्ष आणि छळापासून वाचवण्यासाठी तयार करण्यात आले आहेत, जेणेकरून त्यांना सन्मानाने व सुरक्षिततेने जीवन जगता येईल.

भारतामधील काही महत्त्वाचे प्राणी कल्याण नियम:
• प्राण्यांवर क्रूरता करणे, त्यांना दुखापत करणे किंवा सोडून देणे हे प्राणी क्रूरता प्रतिबंधक कायदा, 1960 अंतर्गत गुन्हा आहे.
• रस्त्यावरील किंवा सामुदायिक प्राण्यांना अन्न देणे व काळजी घेणे कायदेशीर आहे.
• जखमी किंवा आजारी प्राण्यांना त्वरित वैद्यकीय उपचार देणे आवश्यक आहे.

Animal Birth Control isn’t just about animals—it’s about creating healthier communities and ensuring humane, long-term care.
ABC programs help control stray populations ethically, reduce conflicts, prevent the spread of diseases, and improve the quality of life for both animals and people.
Responsible, compassionate solutions begin with awareness and action.

Worst experience.💔

I rescued a severely injured stray cat who was left to die on the road. One of his legs was badly damaged, and with genuine intention to save his life, I brought him here hoping he would receive proper treatment.

Instead of focusing on immediate care or suggesting alternate support options, I was asked to pay ₹5,000–₹6,000 upfront, while being told the total treatment could cost around ₹22,000. As someone who tried to help purely on humanitarian grounds, this was extremely discouraging.

I clearly explained my financial situation and honestly said that I could manage only ₹600–₹700 from my side, which was my genuine capacity. Unfortunately, there was no flexibility, no discussion about raising donations through their network, social media, or other sponsors — which I believe NGOs usually do.

If NGOs start asking large amounts from people who rescue and bring injured strays, then many good-hearted people will stop helping animals altogether. This defeats the very purpose of animal welfare.

With a heavy heart, I had no option but to leave the cat there, feeling helpless and guilty, knowing he might continue to suffer.

This experience was emotionally distressing and disappointing.

featured_reviews.review_text:
visit to this local bird sanctuary is a rejuvenating experience that brings you closer to nature. This sanctuary serve as vital havens for both resident and migratory birds, offering a peaceful environment for bird watching, photography, and ecological learning. Whether you're a casual visitor, an avid ornithologist, or a nature lover, a local bird sanctuary provides a refreshing break from urban life.

Most local bird sanctuaries are thoughtfully developed around wetlands, lakes, or forested areas, with well-maintained walking trails, viewing platforms, and interpretative signboards. During early mornings or late afternoons, visitors can witness a wide variety of bird species such as kingfishers, egrets, herons, storks, and sometimes even rare migratory species depending on the season. The peaceful sounds of bird calls, rustling leaves, and chirping insects enhance the immersive natural experience.

These sanctuaries also serve an important role in conservation, acting as protected zones where biodiversity is preserved and studied. Some offer guided tours or nature camps for students and families, making them excellent spots for educational outings.

Entry fees are usually nominal, making them accessible to the general public. Facilities such as restrooms, benches, drinking water, and sometimes even cafés or eco-shops are available in better-managed sanctuaries.

Overall, a visit to a local bird sanctuary is not only calming and enjoyable but also fosters appreciation for the environment and the importance of wildlife conservation.

Around 15-20 minutes walk from Nahur Railway station

featured_reviews.name: Gyro Infographic
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recent update December 2022:

Entry point to bird-watching area
Timings: 6 Am to 6 PM
Entry fee: INR 50 for adult, Cycle ride available for additional INR 50/cycle.

Recent update December 2022: Ferry boat service has been restarted for the first time post lock-down in Nov 2022.
Two 8-Seater boats are available for a 45 minutes to 1 hour ride for Bird-watching and Flamingo safari, depending on the high-low tide timings. The ride cost is INR 400 per person, in addition to the 50 RS entry fee to the park mentioned above. As the numbers of Flamingos and other birds, can change subject to the season and weather on a particular day, it is better to contact the local personnel a day prior to your visit. Maharashtra style breakfast counter is also available at the entry point, which serves Poha, Vadapao, Misal and Tea at usual rates (charged separately). The snacks get ready by 9 AM, so if you are coming early morning, you can inform at the counter and it will be served by the time come back from your bird-watching trail.

The post is guarded by forest security personnel and you will be required to show identification card (Eg. Driving License etc) and make an entry in the register with your address and phone number. These checks are in place to protect the mangrove wildlife area and prohibit any illegal activities. For birdwatchers, photography equipment and private vehicles will be permitted at additional charges (INR 100).
The place is rich in mangrove biodiversity. Flamingos being the main tourist attraction here. Place is generally safe, but it is quite lonely at times so ensure your personal safety. The trails can be muddy and full of mosquitoes in the rain, so wearing full-sleeved clothes, mosquito repellents and ample drinking water is must.

featured_reviews.name: Ajinkya Kasar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary is located near Airoli, Navi Mumbai. It is a unique destination known for its beautiful flamingos and peaceful natural surroundings. The sanctuary is one of the few places in India where you can watch flamingos in their natural habitat.

One of the highlights of this sanctuary is its Flamingo Museum. The museum provides detailed information about flamingos that migrate here from different countries every year. It also displays models and facts about other birds and fishes found in the creek. Visitors can learn about the flamingos' habitat, food, migration patterns, and other interesting facts.

A special feature of the museum is an audio setup where you can hear the sounds of specific birds and animals. The museum also educates visitors about pollution in the creek, its harmful effects, and ways to prevent it. Overall, it is a great educational initiative.

The museum is located at the entrance of the sanctuary. From there, you walk around 200–300 meters through mangroves to reach the flamingo viewing area. On the way, there is a small room displaying the bones of various animals, which adds to the learning experience.

Clean washrooms are available along the path. As the sanctuary lies along the creek, a bamboo bridge has been built for visitors to walk safely towards the viewing point. At the end of the bridge, there is a bamboo platform where you can watch the flamingos in their natural environment. It is a surreal and peaceful experience to see these beautiful birds up close.

This place is perfect for both education and sightseeing and is highly recommended for students, families, and bird lovers. It is easily accessible by auto-rickshaws and cars.

The site provides stunning vistas of the sea and the bridge, making it an ideal spot for photographers. Additionally, a boat facility is available for visitors to enjoy close-up views of the flamingos and the sea.

Ticket prices are ₹55 for adults and ₹35 for students, with an additional parking fee of ₹45 for two-wheelers.

Overall, the visit was both amazing and delightful, offering a deep appreciation of nature. I thoroughly enjoyed my time there and highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Dhopat

The highlight is, of course, the real flamingos — you get to see them in large numbers, and the view is truly mesmerizing. Watching these beautiful birds up close is an unforgettable experience.

Inside the sanctuary, there are many activities to explore. For kids, it’s not just fun but also educational — they get to see different types of fish, learn about nature, and observe birds in their natural habitat. It’s a great way to combine entertainment with knowledge.

The sanctuary also offers boating rides, which give you a closer view of the flamingos and the creek. Another special feature is the bamboo bridge, which takes you through the jungle and towards the sea — walking on it feels like a unique adventure and adds to the overall charm of the visit.

Facilities are decent — entry is ticketed, and pay-and-use washrooms are available. However, there are no food shops inside, so it’s better to carry your own snacks and water. Parking is available nearby, which makes it convenient for visitors.

Overall, Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary is a hidden gem in Navi Mumbai — a perfect mix of nature, wildlife, and adventure. The serene environment, the sight of flamingos, and the learning opportunities for kids make it a must-visit place for families. 🌿🦩🚤

featured_reviews.name: D Joseph
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Heartfelt Thank You to TATF & Deepa

As many of our friends know, 2023 didn’t end gently for us. It was a time filled with grief, long days, and sleepless nights.

But in that silence, we realized we might need someone to help us through.

Not something impulsive, not a rushed decision, just an unspoken understanding between the two of us that perhaps the love we had to give wasn’t meant to stop.

And that’s when fate stepped in.

While scrolling through Instagram one night, I came across The Anubis-Tiger Foundation. Something nudged me to send a message, just putting it out there that we were open to welcoming a pup in need of a home.

I didn’t expect a reply so soon. But within a few hours, Deepa reached out - with a photo of an angel who, as it turned out, was waiting for us too.

The moment we saw her, we just knew.
She was ours. And we were hers.

Despite everything, I never imagined it would all happen so quickly. But perhaps that’s because I hadn’t realized just how many people are out there giving up their pets, sometimes for heartbreaking reasons. It left me sad, confused, and questioning how anyone could let go of such love.

But I’ll be honest - we’re also thankful.

Because if that family hadn’t made their decision, we would’ve never met Aura.

On 21st January 2024, we brought her home. We braced ourselves, thinking she might take time to adjust after a year with her previous family.

But Aura had other plans.

Within a day, she chose us - just as we had chosen her. She knew she was home.

She changed everything. The energy, the silence, the air itself. And her name came so naturally: Aura.

We went into this thinking we were rescuing her. But in truth, she rescued us.

We are so grateful to have her in our lives.

Thank you, Deepa, you who don’t just find homes for these beautiful souls, but make sure they find the right ones.

She doesn’t hand them over to just anyone. She takes the time to check, to understand, and to ensure that the home is one filled with the love, care, and stability every animal deserves.

Thank you, Anubis Foundation.
And thank you to the angel above who showed us the way.

❤️

featured_reviews.name: Deepali Sengupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sometimes you come across a place that quietly restores your faith in kindness. In Defense of Animals (IDA) in Deonar, Mumbai, is one of those rare places. For over two decades, they’ve been caring for animals who have been abandoned, injured, blind, or living with disabilities — and here, they’re not just treated… they are truly seen. They are fed, healed, and given a chance to feel safe again.
Watching the IDA team care for these little souls with such patience and compassion is deeply moving. Their work is gentle, honest, and full of heart, and it reminds you how powerful simple kindness can be.
Sharing this because such goodness deserves to be acknowledged. And if anyone ever feels like extending even a small gesture of support, IDA is a place where it truly reaches those who need it most. ❤️
